(() => { const rows = (s) => [...document.querySelectorAll(s+' tbody tr')].map(tr => [...tr.querySelectorAll('td')].map(td => td.textContent.trim()));
 return JSON.stringify({roles: rows('[aria-label=usage-roles]'), lanes: rows('[aria-label=usage-lanes]'), ms: rows('[aria-label=usage-milestones]'), waste: rows('[aria-label=usage-waste-tokens]'), groups: rows('[aria-label=waste-groups]'), thr: rows('[aria-label=throttled-intervals]'), run: document.querySelector('[aria-label=throttled-run]').textContent, thrTok: document.querySelector('[aria-label=usage-throttled-tokens]').textContent, cmp: rows('[aria-label=usage-model-comparison]')}); })()
E
agent-browser --session $S eval "$(cat /tmp/cells.js)" > /tmp/cells.json; python3 - <<'E'
import json
dom=json.loads(json.loads(open('/tmp/cells.json').read()))
cli=json.load(open('/tmp/cli-metrics.json'))
bad=0; n=0
def chk(name, a, b):
    global bad,n
    n+=1
    if str(a)!=str(b): bad+=1; print("DIFF",name,a,b)
tr={r['role']:r['tokens'] for r in cli['tokens_by_role']}
cr={r['role']:r for r in cli['cost_by_role']}
for row in dom['roles']:
    t=tr[row[0]]
    chk(row[0]+' in',row[1],t['input']);chk(row[0]+' out',row[2],t['output']);chk(row[0]+' cr',row[3],t['cache_read'])
    chk(row[0]+' cost',row[4],'%.2f'%cr[row[0]]['cost']['amount'])
chk('roles n',len(dom['roles']),len(cli['tokens_by_role']))
for row,l in zip(dom['lanes'],cli['tokens_by_lane']):
    t=l['tokens']; chk('lane '+l['lane'],row[1:4],[str(t['input']),str(t['output']),str(t['cache_read'])]); chk('lane cost',row[4],'%.2f'%l['cost']['amount'])
chk('lanes n',len(dom['lanes']),len(cli['tokens_by_lane']))
for row,m in zip(dom['ms'],cli['tokens_by_milestone']):
    t=m['tokens']; chk('ms',row[1:4],[str(t['input']),str(t['output']),str(t['cache_read'])]); chk('ms cost',row[4],'%.2f'%m['cost']['amount'])
tw=cli['tokens_in_waste_by_cause']
for row in dom['waste']:
    t=tw[row[0]]; chk('waste '+row[0],row[1:4],[str(t['input']),str(t['output']),str(t['cache_read'])])
print(dom['thrTok'], cli['tokens_in_waste_by_cause'].get('throttled'))
print(dom['run'], dom['thr'])
print('rows compared',n,'disagreeing',bad)
print(cli.keys())
E
